items.title: David Torkanowsky interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, September 26, 2019
items.q: And you know I’m trying to do my best Jerry Lee type shit.

ctx.x: Oh no, no, no, no. No. But we got together and played through some of his tunes in New Orleans. So it was late, and the crowd was getting restless. What I didn’t know at the time was this was a standard Chuck Berry thing — he sits in his Cadillac with the engine running, sort of near the stage, waiting for somebody to bring him a briefcase of cash before he hits the stage. And this obviously wasn’t included in the George Wein European tour that he got paid in advance for. So he got that — all of a sudden I see…
Well thank you for that story. It’s one of those things, you got fired for playing too good you know?
